speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Which queen? I ask it with the eggs in my hand, so you need not make it a visit. There are queens in your work, and there is the Queen, and I like to know which one has had my lodger.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Neither had me as a guest. The Queen is at Whitehall. The gentlemen of the Inns are taking a rock before her tonight. Nobody asked us. I played a duke at the Cross Keys. He is not a queen, whatever the gown did.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Was there a ruff in it, sir? Mistress likes a ruff when there is a queen. I can understand a ruff. A rock I shall have to be told slowly.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: No ruffs, then. Mark me, I am not grieving for the ruff. I am particular about news that comes home half dressed. Were you asked?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We were not asked. It is heard of only. You may have that sentence, Mistress. You may not have the plot of the afternoon. The Duke can wait. The eggs cannot, if Tuesday is still pancakes.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Tuesday is pancakes if the eggs hold, and Wednesday is fish, and I will not salt Monday to look ready. If you have come home with a purse of court money, it is not going on my board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no purse. The warrant for December's twenty pounds is drawn and moving. I did not fetch it. I am not counting it. I am not calling it mine. The eggs are the only count I want in this kitchen.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: How many eggs, mistress, if a count is allowed? I can count eggs. I cannot count a warrant, and I would rather not learn.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You can count them in the morning, when I say so. Tonight you can heat the water and leave the stair clear. Callers stop at the foot of it. A duke is a caller if he drips on my step, Master Shakespeare.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not dripping, and I am not receiving. The water will do. I am going up. If the masque follows me to the door, tell them the house is dark.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Are you in pain again, sir, or was that last night's word?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Last night's word. Tonight I am tired. The Duke can stay at the Keys, and I am not giving him to the house. You may both keep the eggs.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then take the tiredness upstairs. I have the eggs. I have no ruff, and no queen in the kitchen, and no verdict on a play you will not tell. That is a sufficient Monday. Do not improve it on the stair.
